# F26: The design review’s highs: the ring’s word under it and its count named beside it, a neutral projection range, the critical path in words not red, the late review named once, and Find giving focus back

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/26-design-review.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

the design review of 21 Nov, its highs (docs/reviews/2026-11-design-review.md H1–H5, A1; backlog DR1–DR5, DR10). H3 (the marks' 3:1) is checked on every screen by P6.
